answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns a deposit of twice its 30-day reward, locked 20 epochs and released after work. A vine is pruned before it bears fruit; each identity pays before it earns. Forging 1,000 identities costs 10,000 units against 4,000 in work, so the attack loses money. At dawn the slots open. One honest agent works in the orchard, pays one deposit and keeps undiluted rewards.
